stem.en: A dog whistle makes a sound of 24 000 Hz. Humans hear up to about 20 000 Hz. How many hertz above the top of the human audible range is the whistle?

explanation.en: 24 000 Hz − 20 000 Hz = 4000 Hz. The whistle is ultrasonic: a dog can hear it, but a person cannot.

hints.en: Both numbers are already in the same unit, so this is one subtraction with nothing to convert first.
Draw the two frequencies on a line with zero at the left, then ask how much room there is between the two marks.
